# The dock guides teach the document-valued declared perspective

Leaf of #18605 (parent linked natively). `Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 (§2.1 as amended by #18641)`.

## Context

#18641 (merged 2026-09-13, dev@0b9178b63d) lets a `perspectives` value be an already-lowered `neo.dock.zone.v1` document as well as `zones`: `Authoring.isDocument` discriminates by `schema`, `Authoring.fromDocument` admits the document through the checks a supplied `dockModel` passes, and the selection captures it as a baseline that is never registered (`src/dashboard/dock/interaction/PerspectiveSelection.mjs:94`, `src/dashboard/dock/model/Authoring.mjs:44–56`). ADR 0029 §2.1 carries the amendment; the guides do not. The panes guide's stage-two section (PR #18640, in review) says `perspectives` maps names to the same `zones` vocabulary, and the intro guide's rule 6 says "a map of names to zones" — true, and now incomplete: a host that supplies its own document can declare the arrangement it ships (`perspectives: {shipped: initialDocument}`), which is how the Workstation's baseline arrives under #18612.

## The Problem

A consumer whose arrangement already exists as a document — a shipped snapshot, a generated document, a Group participant's saved main — reads the guides and concludes it must translate the document back into `zones` to declare it, or that it cannot declare at all. The guides teach one of the two admitted forms.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Authoring.fromDocument(document)` returns `fromZones`' result shape; the input is not normalized — an admitted document is its own baseline byte-for-byte.
- `PerspectiveSelection.capture()` chooses per declared entry by `Authoring.isDocument(value)`, so one map may mix both kinds.
- A document-valued entry carries its own items; the `panes` catalog lowers only the `zones`-valued entries.
- `dock.perspective.modified` compares the committed document against the declared baseline whichever kind it was (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/PerspectiveState.mjs:28`).

## The Fix

Three documents, one clause each, no new preview, sequenced after PR #18640 lands (the same sections):

- `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsPanes.md` — the stage-two section states the second admitted form beside the `zones` form (a `neo.dock.zone.v1` document, admitted like a supplied `dockModel`, captured as the baseline byte-for-byte) and when a consumer reaches for it: the arrangement already exists as a document.
- `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts.md` rule 6 — "a map of names to zones or already-lowered documents".
- `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsAdoption.md` — the Decision 5 paragraph names the shipped-document declaration as the way a document-supplying host declares its baseline.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The three passages name the document-valued form, its admission rule (validated like a supplied `dockModel`, never registered, byte-for-byte baseline) and the discriminator (the record's `schema`), with no ticket, PR or Discussion id in any guide.
- [ ] A receipt in the unit runtime, written before the sentences: a workspace declaring `{shipped: <document>, focus: <zones>}` publishes `{active: 'shipped', modified: false}` at construction, reads `modified: true` after one committed change, and switches to `focus` through `activePerspective`.
- [ ] The PR `Refs #18605` and `Resolves` this leaf only; it branches from `dev` after PR #18640 lands.

## Out of Scope

A new live preview; the Workstation's own declaration (#18612); the ADR (amended by #18641); the Neural Link tool descriptions (they name no declaration form).
